relationships.subject: HIF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: vascular endothelial growth factor expression is regulated by hypoxia-inducible factor-1 in the hypoxic conditions of IVDs

key_findings: Review: in symptomatic disc degeneration pro-inflammatory mediators drive catabolism, ECM loss, angiogenesis and neural ingrowth causing discogenic pain.
Aberrant angiogenesis is considered a key initiating step in symptomatic DDD.
